version.description: Current version number of the publication  using semver (e.g., '1.0.0', '2.1.0, 1.2.0-rc')

authors.description: List of authors of the publication

editors.description: Optional list of editors for the publication

reviewers.description: Optional list of reviewers for the publication

publishedDate.description: Date when the publication was published

versionHistory.description: Version history of the publication (summaries of past versions)

content.description: Content of the publication (to be defined by specific implementations)

releaseNotes.description: Optional link to release notes (object or string ID)

else.description: Reference to a release notes identifier
